rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with the provided 2AA label, but the image does not clearly support a tightly packed well-defined ICM or uniformly cohesive TE, and comments on symmetry and zona regularity are somewhat overstated from this single frame.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, smoking, prior IVF outcomes, endometrium, and sperm motility with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and structured, with probability modifiers explained, though some quantitative adjustments are somewhat speculative and a few inferences exceed what can be concluded from the data.

Many recommendations are guideline-consistent (SET, smoking cessation, semen reassessment), but suggestions such as ERA, ReceptivaDx, routine thrombophilia/immunologic workup, and TESE based on DFI are not standard first-line guideline-based recommendations in this scenario.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, though some recommendations are more aggressive than necessary and not all are equally evidence-based.
